Name: JerryBB's Bed Rest - Sheep Dreams
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#F4D698][b]JerryBB's Bed Rest[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#AFC3F0][i]Sheep Dreams[/i][/color][/size]

[size=3]Take a cozy nap in bed [b]without ending the day[/b].[/size][/center]

[size=3]Interact with your bed and choose [color=#F4D698][b]"Nap / Rest"[/b][/color]. While you rest, you recover a portion of your max [color=#9FE3A8]energy[/color] and [color=#F7A1A1]health[/color] every 10 in-game minutes, and a little dream bubble counts sheep above your head.[/size]

[size=4][color=#AFC3F0][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Nap / Rest[/b] option added to the bed dialogue. Normal sleep is unchanged.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Recovers energy and health every 10 in-game minutes ([color=#F4D698]15%[/color] by default).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Sheep dream bubble: [i]One sheep... Two sheep... Zzz...[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Choose what happens after full recovery: [b]keep napping[/b], or [b]wake up[/b].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Move (or press Cancel) to get up at any time.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]English and Korean included.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#AFC3F0][b]Config[/b][/color][/size] [size=2](Generic Mod Config Menu)[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Energy restored every 10 minutes[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Health restored every 10 minutes (0% disables health recovery)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Show sheep bubble[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]After fully restored: keep napping / wake up[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#AFC3F0][b]Installation[/b][/color][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2 or later.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#FF8A8A][b]Translations & Permissions[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#FF8A8A][b]Do NOT translate, re-upload, or redistribute this mod without my explicit permission.[/b][/color]
Unauthorized translations or re-uploads will be reported.
If you would like to translate it, please contact me first.[/size]

[size=4][color=#AFC3F0][b]Credits[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]A heartfelt thank you to the creators who made this mod possible:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Lee Minseo (quiple)[/b] for the lovely [b]Galmuri[/b] pixel font, used for the dream bubble text (SIL Open Font License 1.1).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Pathoschild[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]spacechase0[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=3][color=#F4D698]Sweet dreams, farmers![/color][/size][/center]
